tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Nnọọ, onye ndú na-eto eto. Abụ m Onye Nkuzi Hoshi. Agbụrụ anyị achọtala ndagwurugwu zoro ezo n'ugwu. Ka anyị wuo obodo ndị iro na-agaghị achọta.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Ebe Ịkpụ Ego gị na-akpụ Ego. Mgbe mkpụrụ ego na-efe n'elu ya, pịa ya, wee pịa Nara.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Agbụrụ na-adabere n'Ego. Pịa Wuo wee tinye Ebe Ịkpụ Ego.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Ugbu a mee ka Obi Agbụrụ sie ike: pịa ụlọ elu ahụ, wee pịa Kwalite.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Nkwalite na-ewe oge. Obi ga-adị njikere n'ime {time}: lọghachi mgbe ahụ, ma ọ bụ pịa Mechaa ugbu a iji jiri ntakịrị Jed.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!
tutorial.finishKeep.done.text: Obi adịla njikere. I mere nke ọma!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Agbụrụ ndị iro ga-awakpo anyị. Wuo Ụlọ Elu Kunai n'akụkụ Obi (Wuo, wee pịa taabụ Nchekwa): ọ na-agba onye mwakpo ọ bụla nọ nso.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Wuo Dojo Ọzụzụ, Ogige Ndị Agha na Ụlọ Elu Kunai n'akụkụ Obi (Wuo: taabụ Agha, wee taabụ Nchekwa).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Mepee ngalaba Agha wee zụọ ụfọdụ Shinobi: mma ọsọ ọsọ na-awakpo ụlọ kacha nso.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Ọzụzụ na-ewekwa oge: ndị dike gị ga-adị njikere n'ime {time}. Chere, ma ọ bụ pịa Mechaa ọzụzụ iji jiri ntakịrị Jed.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Mwakpo mbụ gị. Pịa Wakpo, lelee ebe a na-awakpo, wee pịa Wakpo! N'ọgbọ agha, m ga-egosi gị otu ihe n'otu oge: zipu Shinobi gị site n'ebe na-enwu enwu, wee tinye ha n'anwụrụ ọkụ mgbe ha ruru ụlọ elu: ndị dike nọ n'ime anwụrụ ọkụ ka a pụrụ ịgba naanị site nso.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: I lụrụ nke ọma. Kwalite Dojo Ọzụzụ iji meghee Ndị Mmebi Nzuzo: ha na-akpọchi ihe nchekwa ruo sekọnd ole na ole. Kpọchie mbụ, wee wakpo, ma tinye ndị dike gị n'anwụrụ ọkụ ebe ọkụ kacha sie ike. Nara, kwalite, wakpo, ma sonye na Njikọ.

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Otu ihe nrite kwa ụbọchị, otu ihe ahụ maka onye ọ bụla, ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụ ịkpa ụmụ ma ọ dịghị mgbe a na-ere ya. Ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ otu ụbọchị, ọ dịghị ihe na-efu: nnata ọzọ bụ ụbọchị na-esote na ndepụta. Ụbọchị 28 na-enye ọdịdị Obi.

calendar.gotLook.en: A new Keep look is yours: Store → Looks.
calendar.gotLook.text: Ọdịdị Obi ọhụrụ bụ nke gị: Ụlọ Ahịa → Ọdịdị.

offers.noAge.en: Special offers appear only once you have told us your age (Settings → Account → Spending → Set age group).
offers.noAge.text: Onyinye pụrụ iche na-apụta naanị mgbe ị gwara anyị afọ gị (Ntọala → Akaụntụ → Mmefu → Tọọ otu afọ).

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: Onyinye pụrụ iche anaghị apụta maka ndị egwuregwu na-erubeghị afọ 18. Ihe niile dị na taabụ Jed ka dị n'ime oke mmefu gị.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Nnyefe na-amalite ozugbo: ị nwere ike ịnara ụgwọ mbụ ugbu a na otu ọzọ kwa ụbọchị; site n'ịzụ, ị kwenyere na ị tụfuru ikike ịkagbu, dịka iwu kwere maka ihe dijitalụ.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Ịzụ ahịa ahụ agaghị. Ọ bụrụ na e wepụrụ ego gị, a ga-enyefe ya ozugbo ụlọ ahịa kwadoro ya.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Ọ dịghị dike lụrụ ọgụ, ya mere a gụrụ ya dịka mmega ahụ.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Kpụzie {building} niile otu mgbe. Ogologo na-agba ebe dị anya karịa mana ọ na-adaba nwayọọ ma na-ebu ụzọ chọọ ndị dike nọ n'azụ; Mgbawa na-akụ otu ìgwè mana ọ na-agba nwayọọ; Nche na-eme ka Ụlọ Elu Ụta Mbara Igwe, Ite Ọkụ Anwụrụ Ilu na ọnya sie ike karịa. Ndị mwakpo na-ahụ ọdịdị ahụ mgbe ha na-enyocha.

temper.left.en: {n, plural, one {# point left} other {# points left}}

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.
temper.done.text: Ekpụziela: {building} ọ bụla nwere ọdịdị ọhụrụ ya.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Nche na-emekwa ka ọgwụgwọ, ọmụmụ ọzọ, ike na mkpuchi ọta nke ndị mwakpo dị ala n'ebe niile.

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Kwupụta nsonaazụ tupu i wakpo: ruo ya ma buru ihe nkwata karịa laa, ma ọ bụ tụfuo ya ma ghara ibu ihe ọ bụla.
